environment.description: Same container image deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint policy restricts aws:SourceVpc to vpc-0xdeadbeef only. The NLB target group performs TCP health checks on port 8080 but the Network Load Balancer has no public IP and no Elastic IP association. Route tables for the subnet contain only local VPC CIDR (10.0.48.0/20) and the VPC endpoint prefix list — no 0.0.0.0/0 route exists. Additionally, the endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning only pre-approved AWS accounts can establish connections. DNS is configured with a private hosted zone (internal-api.corp.example.com) that resolves only within the consumer VPC.

config.network: isolated private subnet, no IGW, no NAT
config.route_table: local 10.0.48.0/20 only, pl-vpce prefix list, no default route
config.dns: private hosted zone, no public DNS resolution
